volume.meridian_story.yunxi_lower.note: Two indigo ties hold the lower scroll beside the upper one in the gravekeeper’s pack.
codex.source.meridian_story.yunxi_lower: Two indigo ties hold the lower scroll beside the upper one in the gravekeeper’s pack.
codex.power.meridian_story.yunxi_lower: Open two hand meridians and one foot meridian. Channel true qi through your sword to strike with Cloud Cleaver, Shadow Return and Twin Pearls.
technique.meridian_story.cloud_cleaver.n: Cut diagonally from above at a single foe. A parry brings your blade partway into the cut.
technique.meridian_story.shadow_return.n: Twist to sweep your sword at someone behind you, then snap back. Keep facing forward.
technique.meridian_story.twin_pearls.not: Strike twice in a row at someone in front of you. If they step back, the second strike misses.
technique.meridian_story.flash_parry.not: Raise your blade across your brow. Catch the incoming blow and draw back into a diagonal cut.
story.meridian_story.road.walk: On the road alone, you remember the waybill in a stray soldier’s collar. Look for one when someone bars your way.
story.meridian_story.road.lodge: Charcoal smudges the corner of the waybill. Warm your hands at a campfire and speak to the porter there.
story.meridian_story.road.scene: The footman spots the waybill in your hand and shifts aside to make room for you by the fire.
story.meridian_story.road.waybill_receiv: The footman takes the waybill from your hand.
story.meridian_story.road.greeting: Rough road tonight. Walk with me a while? If you’d sooner go alone, I have a road token.
story.meridian_story.road.escort: Hand over the waybill and escort him
story.meridian_story.road.solo: Hand over the waybill and take the token alone
story.meridian_story.road.escort_reply: Keep the stub. If they catch us, listen for my call. I know a way through.
story.meridian_story.road.solo_reply: Take this token. If they come after you, show it to me for a way out.
story.meridian_story.road.night_escort: Pocket the stub, open your first meridian, then head out. Survive the night; when pursuers arrive, the footman will point the way—fight or slip clear.
story.meridian_story.road.night_solo: Open your first meridian, take the road token, and head out to survive the night. If pursuers find you, ask the footman to switch routes or break free on your own.
story.meridian_story.road.guide: Quick, down this path beside me!
story.meridian_story.road.exchange: Hand over the road token and slip down the side path
story.meridian_story.road.return_escort: The escort is done, dust thick on your boots. Gripping the stub, you return to the fire to claim your rations from the footman.
story.meridian_story.road.return_solo: You outrun the pursuers and hurry back to the campfire, breathing hard. You pull out the receipt for the footman to inspect.
story.meridian_story.road.give_food: Hand over the stub and claim the rations
story.meridian_story.road.give_pass: Present the receipt and claim the pass
story.meridian_story.road.end_escort: Thanks for seeing me through. Here, a loaf for the road.
story.meridian_story.road.end_solo: There’s your stamp. Take care at the forks ahead.
story.meridian_story.road.camp: The firelight warms your hands. You claim this camp.
Frayed edges, flecked with dried mud.
letter.meridian_story.lone_star.escort_s: Show this to the footman by the fire for rations.
letter.meridian_story.lone_star.road_tok: Bring to the footman to switch routes when pursued.
letter.meridian_story.lone_star.safe_stu: A guiding receipt given after the footman takes your token.
letter.meridian_story.lone_star.loaf.lor: Hearty wheat scent, in thanks for the escort.
letter.meridian_story.lone_star.pass.lor: Crisp seal. Carry this for the roads ahead.
story.meridian_story.road.follow: Follow the porter down the side path
book.meridian_story.yunxi.note: Your foster father left two volumes. The first relies on arm strength, the second on true qi.
volume.meridian_story.yunxi_upper.note: Indigo cord binds the upper scroll your foster father left in the gravekeeper’s pack.
technique.meridian_story.wind_thrust.not: The point shoots straight ahead. A step to the side lets it pass.
technique.meridian_story.moon_lift.note: The point lifts in a short arc, catching two foes standing shoulder to shoulder.
technique.meridian_story.yunxi_sword_req: Take a sword in hand first.
codex.source.meridian_story.yunxi_upper: Indigo cord binds the upper scroll your foster father left in the gravekeeper’s pack.
codex.power.meridian_story.yunxi_upper: Thrust at a distant foe, sweep at two standing close, or raise the blade across your brow to parry.
story.meridian_story.reborn.roll: Name in the old ledger. Someone asks after you along the road. When they arrive, check where their leader falls.
story.meridian_story.reborn.seal: Reversed seal. You spot your past life's death date on the torn page. That ferry seal broke long ago—why is this mark still backward? Ask a villager to compare seals, or keep the paper and wait for the next crew's counter-seal.
story.meridian_story.reborn.alone: You tuck the torn page close. Watch the road, wait for the next leader to show, and seize their counter-seal to compare.
story.meridian_story.reborn.ledger: Name added after death. You press the two seal marks together. Ask someone by the village bell to check the old register; if no village is nearby, wait for the next crew carrying a ledger copy.
story.meridian_story.reborn.sign: Altered signature. After your death, someone claimed your stored goods under your name. Hand the testimony to a witness, or wait for the next wave and seize the forged seal.
story.meridian_story.reborn.hand: Hand over page to match seals
story.meridian_story.reborn.compare_repl: This seal is backward. Take it.
story.meridian_story.reborn.archive_repl: It's in the register. Keep this testimony safe.
story.meridian_story.reborn.carry_reply: If you're taking it, hold onto this page yourself.
story.meridian_story.reborn.publish_repl: I'll correct the old record for you, and put in a good word.
letter.meridian_story.reborn.fragment.lo: Frayed paper edges. Black ink clearly marks the death date of your past life.
A backward mark pressed into the paper. Left by the broken old seal from the ferry.
letter.meridian_story.reborn.testimony.l: Dry ink on testimony. States someone used your name to claim stored goods after you died.
letter.meridian_story.reborn.private_let: Stamped with the forged seal. The old case is clear, yet your foes will still come.
letter.meridian_story.reborn.public_lett: Only the forged signature is corrected here. Record set straight, yet your foes will come again.
origin.meridian_story.ordinary.name: Ordinary Upbringing
origin.meridian_story.ordinary.story: You grew up in an ordinary family down the street, often tending the stove as a child.
origin.meridian_story.lone_star.story: Growing up with courier caravans, you faced trouble even at inn doors. Years on the road made you tougher than most.
origin.meridian_story.lone_star.talent.1: Sprinting, leaping, or swinging—you outlast others at the same work.
origin.meridian_story.lone_star.talent.2: Even badly hurt, you can grit your teeth and force out a few quick strikes. Once that surge fades, you must recover before doing it again.
origin.meridian_story.lone_star.threat.1: When opening your meridians, you must hold that breath a little longer than others.
origin.meridian_story.lone_star.threat.2: You often run into people looking for a fight on the road.
origin.meridian_story.lone_star.name: Lone Star
effect.meridian_story.gritted_counter.no: Though badly hurt, a surge of strength in your arms lets you strike faster for a while.
story.meridian_story.reborn.seal_greetin: Will you let me see the seal on the torn page?
story.meridian_story.reborn.ledger_greet: What will you do with the signed page in the old ledger?
story.meridian_story.reborn.sign_greetin: Will you leave your testimony to set this old case right?
chat.meridian_story.replaced: You put away the replacement paper.
chat.meridian_story.later: You take your leave for now. You can come back another day.
chat.meridian_story.defer: Leave for now and return another day
story.meridian_story.reborn.seal_scene: A villager holds out an open palm before you, waiting to see the seal.
story.meridian_story.reborn.ledger_scene: By the village bell, a villager opens an old ledger before you, not writing yet.
story.meridian_story.reborn.sign_scene: You step up to the witness. He stops what he's doing, waiting for you to speak.
origin.meridian_story.grave_keeper.name: Sword Tomb Keeper
origin.meridian_story.grave_keeper.story: Adopted and raised by a swordsman in your youth. After his passing, you carry his old sword and watch over his grave.
origin.meridian_story.grave_keeper.talen: You wear your foster father’s old sword. His notes, both volumes of the Yunxi Sword Manual and a guide to his grave lie in your pack.
origin.meridian_story.grave_keeper.threa: Stay away from your adoptive father too long, and your mind grows restless.
Old acquaintances will trace the past and seek you out at the tomb.
effect.meridian_story.homesick.note: You haven't visited the grave in too long; your heart can't seem to settle.
item.meridian_story.grave_marker.lore: Moss covers a corner of the low headstone, its stone surface cold to the touch.
item.meridian_story.grave_sword.lore: The indigo cloth wrapped around the hilt has faded to gray, yet it still feels steady in your hand.
item.meridian_story.grave_guide.lore: Follow the vermilion line on the paper; at its end lies your adoptive father's grave.
item.meridian_story.yunxi_notes.lore: Old papers left behind by your adoptive father, with a tea stain on the corner of a page.
story.meridian_story.tomb.directions: You follow the vermilion line on the paper to find the tomb: Overworld (%s, %s, %s).
story.meridian_story.tomb.wait: The ink on the guide hasn't settled; the sword tomb's location remains unknown.
story.meridian_story.tomb.swept: You brush the moss from the headstone and sit quietly before your adoptive father for a while.
story.meridian_story.tomb.sad: You haven't visited your adoptive father in days, and your mind keeps wandering.
book.meridian_story.yunxi_notes.page: That year, just as the autumn rain stopped, he came to my house clutching an old sword to ask for wine. I remember a sliver of moonlight flashing beneath the hem of his robe, followed a breath later by two crisp chimes close together under the veranda. Only after the second sound settled did he finally drop his stiff airs. He leaned his sword by the door, warmed his hands by the hearth, and even complained that the tea I brewed was too weak—when he was the one who had promised to bring the wine.
story.meridian_story.friend.name: Senior Zhou
story.meridian_story.friend.scene: Footsteps stop behind you. Your father's old friend holds a bunch of wildflowers.
story.meridian_story.friend.greeting: You're the child who always watched him wipe his sword, aren't you? How fast you've grown. I picked some wildflowers. May I set them by his stone?
story.meridian_story.friend.welcome: Take the wildflowers and set them by the stone
story.meridian_story.friend.refuse: Ask him to take the wildflowers away
story.meridian_story.friend.thanks: Thank you. After cleaning his sword he used to sit on the porch and look at these flowers.
story.meridian_story.friend.hurt: Very well. I'll take them with me.
item.meridian_story.grave_fragment.lore: A broken edge Zhou kept for your father.
story.meridian_story.tomb.repaired: You smooth the notch out of the blade.
story.meridian_story.tomb.reforge_cost: Uses one iron ingot and one fragment. The previous sword loses its mark.
story.meridian_story.fallen.opening: You hear someone breathing in the grass by the bend. A cultivator lies curled in the mud, his coat torn and one corner of his scroll dark with blood. When you crouch, he can still pull it closer to his chest. A loose stone rattles beyond the bend. Then it goes quiet.
story.meridian_story.fallen.rescue: Dress his wound and give him medicine
story.meridian_story.fallen.rescue.cost: This will take one Potion of Healing. Anyone on his trail may come after you too.
story.meridian_story.fallen.leave.cost: Leave him here with his belongings.
story.meridian_story.fallen.rescue.good: He opens his eyes and looks from you to the scroll under his palm. “Take the clean end.” This time he holds it out to you.
story.meridian_story.fallen.rescue.bad: You have just tied the bandage when a shout comes from the bend. “Stop the one helping him, too!” The wounded man uses your arm to get to his feet.
story.meridian_story.fallen.escort.safe: The footsteps fade. He leans on you until he can speak and points back to the fork. “That's where they came up.”
story.meridian_story.fallen.escort.lost: When you look back, he's gone. A scrap of the bandage you tied catches in the grass.
story.meridian_story.fallen.escort.died: You lift your head from his side. The hand that held your sleeve has gone slack.
story.meridian_story.fallen.wrest.good: The scroll comes free in your hand. You look back along the bend. The road is empty.
story.meridian_story.fallen.wrest.bad: You pull the scroll free and rub the cover with your thumb. Beneath the drying blood, half a red seal and the name of his school are still legible.
story.meridian_story.fallen.wrest.missed: You step back to the roadside. The bloodstained scroll is still held against his chest.
story.meridian_story.fallen.school: Someone at the crossroads holds up a red seal. “You recognize this from the cover, don't you?”
story.meridian_story.fallen.leave.done: You walk on around the bend. For a few steps you can still hear him breathing. Then all you hear is the scuff of your own boots.
story.meridian_story.fallen.gone: You return to the spot where you met. They're gone.
